Name: (CP)(AT)Song Ke's Chinese Horse
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b][size=3][color=#e69138]* 介绍 *[/color]
*introduce *[/size][/b]

[color=#f6b26b]这是一组小马与马具，它们在设计时参考了中式的马匹与马具，并进行了许多艺术加工！[/color]
This is a set of horses and their harnesses. They were designed by drawing inspiration from ancient Chinese horses and harnesses, and numerous artistic enhancements were made!

[color=#f6b26b]一共有7种马匹颜色、9种马具款式。[/color]
There are a total of 7 horse colors and 9 types of horse equipment styles, which can be switched in the MOD options within the game settings.
[i][u]
[/u][/i][size=3][i][color=#f6b26b]    ***感谢咪老师新增的AT版本！***[/color]
    ***Thank you to catissocute for adding the AT version!***[/i][/size]

[color=#f6b26b]CP版可在游戏设置里的MOD选项中切换；[/color]
The CP version can be switched in the MOD option within the game settings; 

[color=#f6b26b]AT版在木匠罗宾处购买剪刀工具，在小马身上左键使用剪刀切换。[/color]
The AT version, you can purchase the scissors tool from the carpenter Robin and use the left mouse button to switch on the horse.

[color=#f6b26b]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.


————————————————————————————————————
[size=3][color=#93c47d]* 使用方式 *[/color]
[b]* How to use *[/b]
[/size]
[color=#93c47d]一共有两种版本，可二选一下载。[/color]
There are two versions available, and you can choose to download either one.

[size=3][b]CP版：[/b][/size]
[color=#93c47d]确保下载了 [/color][b]SMAPI[/b][color=#93c47d] 和 [/color][b]ContentPatcher[/b][color=#93c47d]。[/color]
Make sure to download [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]ContentPatcher[/b].

[color=#93c47d]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.

[b][size=3]AT版：[/size][/b]
[color=#93c47d]确保下载了[/color] [b]SMAPI[/b] 和 [b]Alternative Textures[/b]。
Make sure to download[b] SMAPI[/b] and [b]Alternative Textures[/b].

[color=#93c47d]下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/color]
Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.
